name: Military Tech Labs: F35
summary:
Welcome to Military Technology Lab, an interactive aerospace learning experience centered around one of the world's most advanced aircraft: the F-35 Lightning II.

Unlike a flight simulator, Military Technology Lab is designed as a virtual technology museum where curiosity drives exploration. Walk around the aircraft, a turbofan jet engine, the cockpit and F-35 helmet, examine the systems up close, and select individual components to learn how they work.
